-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "public"."notes" (
  "id" bigint generated always as identity not null,
  "title" text not null,
  constraint "notes_pkey" primary key ("id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-function
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create function "public"."touch_notes"() returns trigger language plpgsql volatile security invoker as $okm$begin return new; end$okm$;

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-trigger
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create trigger "notes_touch" before insert or update of "title" on "public"."notes" for each row when (new.title <> '') execute function "public"."touch_notes"();
